name: conversation-handoff
description: Distill long ChatGPT conversations into compact, loss-minimized continuation state for clean-session handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Continue long chats with less context
interface.longDescription: Condense the active conversation into a dense continuation state that preserves decisions, exact values, dependencies, unresolved work, and the next action while removing conversational noise.
defaultPrompt: Condense this conversation and prepare a clean-session handoff.
Checkpoint this chat so I can continue without the context bloat.
